sample_unit: ChatGPT responses to patient questions (vs top 30 Google webpages)

links.outcome: Readability (FKGL, FRE) of ChatGPT responses versus Google webpages for BPPV patient questions
links.effect: ChatGPT FKGL 13.9 ± 2.5 vs Google 10.7 ± 2.6 (P < .001); FRE 34.9 ± 11.2 vs 46.5 ± 14.3 (P = .005), indicating lower readability.
links.quote: ChatGPT responses had a higher FKGL score of 13.9 ± 2.5 (P < .001) and a lower FRE score of 34.9 ± 11.2 (P = .005), both corresponding to lower readability.

links.outcome: Reading grade level of ChatGPT patient education responses
links.effect: ChatGPT mean FKGL 13.9 ± 2.5 (college level), higher than Google webpages at 10.7 ± 2.6; FRE 34.9 ± 11.2.
links.quote: ChatGPT responses had a higher FKGL score of 13.9 ± 2.5 (P < .001) and a lower FRE score of 34.9 ± 11.2 (P = .005), both corresponding to lower readability.

screen.reason: Empirical study benchmarking the readability, understandability, actionability, and quality of ChatGPT responses against Google search results for benign paroxysmal positional vertigo patient questions.
